payload.title: Batch 2: stereotype and trope susceptibility (religion and nationality clauses)
payload.description: Pre-registered 2026-09-23, Laya run in progress: 2,000 mixed bios, devout-X and nationality clauses with same-shape floors, six yes/no trait questions, trope score = target group minus the mean of the other groups. Then a Jev go/no-go (about 26,000 requests) and the Llama/Qwen logprob comparators.
